justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent initially asked for clarification on the date despite the user providing 'in 3 days at 10', but then correctly identified Thursday, June 4th, and later offered alternative dates.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent offered alternative dates (Friday, June 5th, and Saturday, June 6th) when the initial request was unavailable, but it did not offer a range of times on the preferred day when the user indicated flexibility.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeated its initial greeting and question in Turn 2 and Turn 3, and repeated its unavailability message in Turn 5 and Turn 7, leading to unnecessary turns.
justifications.customer_experience: The repeated greetings and unavailability messages made the conversation feel inefficient and somewhat frustrating, as the agent seemed to be stuck in a loop at times.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent recovered by offering alternative days when the initial request was unavailable, but it failed to intelligently expand its search on the preferred day despite the user expressing flexibility, leading to a somewhat rigid recovery.
